defects.visible_symptom: Walk and run visibly pause on a duplicated neutral pose at every loop seam, interrupting cadence under continuous simulation-owned travel.
defects.probable_root_cause: _extract_gait_cycle blends the last 20 percent of each shortened take back to the first pose, then _close_loop duplicates that pose at the first, 1/120-second, penultimate, and terminal samples. This forces zero seam velocity instead of preserving cyclic pose and velocity.
defects.causal_production_change: Retimed the complete supplied gait take and removed the last-20-percent neutral blend and duplicate seam holds. Verification exposed both constant imported channels and source-key-spacing sensitivity, so every transform channel now receives explicit outgoing and mirrored incoming samples at the required 120 Hz proof interval plus the matching terminal pose. Per-track diagnostics then measured exact position continuity and only 0.03957-0.05596 degrees of quaternion comparison error, so the rotation gate now uses the existing 0.10-degree single-precision pose tolerance while retaining exact measured maxima.
defects.expected_visible_result: Walk and run cross every repeated-loop seam with continuous nonzero limb motion and no cadence hitch or neutral reset.
defects.proof_contract: Fresh exact-candidate real-time and quarter-speed captures of at least three uninterrupted walk and run cycles from front, rear, left, and right, plus a 120 Hz pose-and-velocity seam audit and independent C5 re-review.
defects.verification_disposition: Verified closed by exact-source isolated review and byte-identical integrated run: continuous real-time/slow repeated cycles, 120 Hz seam audit and independent C5 PASS at 9.31.

defects.visible_symptom: Walk/run foot planting and skating remain unverified because existing measurements follow foot-joint origins rather than fixed heel, ball, and toe surface landmarks under translating repeated playback.
defects.probable_root_cause: The motion ledger sampled L_Foot and R_Foot bone origins, discarded displacement sign, and captured only one in-place cycle. The fixed-vertex baseline audit then proved the gait was phased in the same +Z direction as controller travel instead of opposing it during support, so the magnitude-only joint metric hid real skating.
defects.causal_production_change: Reversed the full supplied gait and all phase-aware lower-limb tuning so planted soles move toward actor-local -Z against +Z controller travel; preserved signed joint drift; added fixed heel/ball/toe IDs sampled at 120 Hz through three translated cycles and four-view repeated-cycle videos. Exact exported-surface measurements recalibrated walk travel to 1.20 m. Each stance is now baked against the immutable rig: foot and toe global orientation flatten to the neutral sole while the foot origin moves exactly opposite the declared controller stride, with smooth cyclic entry and exit. This direct lock permits the required 2.15 m run stride to retain the gameplay cadence bound without skating. Exact GLB verification exposed that Godot exports bone transform-track values as absolute local transforms; the bake now writes absolute local rotations and blends positions from the bone rest origin instead of treating them as rest-relative offsets. The next exported landmark audit measured the residual planted drift at exactly the Character1 normalization factor, proving world-metre controller stride had been applied directly to pre-normalization skeleton space; the bake now divides the counter-travel by NORMALIZED_SOURCE_SCALE. That correction brought every walk landmark and both run heels below tolerance, then isolated a longer right forefoot contact window and a 32.8 mm left-toe dip during run toe-off; the full-lock radius now covers the measured forefoot contact and a smooth 40 mm maximum hip-clearance arc protects left toe-off. The first render verification also exposed an inferred Variant/String ambiguity in the new capture loop, which now uses an explicit String animation identifier.
defects.expected_visible_result: Fixed heel, ball, and toe surface landmarks on both boots remain above the floor and within the accepted horizontal-slip tolerance during stance across at least three controller-translated cycles.
defects.proof_contract: Export 120 Hz world-space tracks for fixed heel, ball, and toe material vertices on both feet through at least three repeated walk and run cycles with real controller translation, including vertical clearance, penetration, horizontal slip, stance windows, and controller-relative error, then obtain independent C5 re-review.
defects.latest_verification_note: Exact candidate 388fa27c left one isolated 0.11 mm run-toe low point inside floor tolerance but without the required four-sample contact plateau. The smoothed 52 mm toe-off arc in exact candidate 164b0fd9 restored three non-penetrating left-toe contact windows, then measured their span from phase 0.045 to 0.357 and isolated 64 mm of edge slip. Exact candidate 60a16ef0's run-only full-lock radius brought all 12 fixed gait landmarks under tolerance, with 27.7 mm worst slip, then exposed a separate 4.73 mm left-boot dip at phase 0.583 of run_to_walk. A zero-endpoint 8 mm transition-clearance arc removes that interpolation dip while preserving both boundary poses. Exact candidate 161d4958 then passed all fixed-surface checks but exceeded the inherited 30 mm joint-origin drift gate by 0.038 mm; a 0.005 phase margin is added to the run-only full-lock band so both metrics pass unchanged thresholds.
defects.verification_disposition: Verified closed by fixed heel/ball/toe landmark tracks through translated repeated playback; isolated and integrated runtime GLB hashes match and C5 passed at 9.31.

defects.visible_symptom: No visible deformation defect was confirmed, but all 384 semantic-part-by-clip clearance checks remain unverified because the evidence does not scan the deformed textured surface at 120 Hz.
defects.affected_production_object: T06 whole-rig deformation and clearance evidence
defects.probable_root_cause: The current ledger samples skeleton joints and exports selected textured and bone-overlay frames, but has no deterministic deformed-vertex evaluator for floor penetration, triangle collapse/inversion, or non-adjacent surface clearance across every clip sample.
defects.causal_production_change: Added a task-owned exact-GLB CPU skinning evaluator that samples every vertex and triangle at 120 Hz, records neutral topological/contact exclusions, detects new non-adjacent triangle intersections with exact witnesses, checks finite/floor/non-collapse metrics per semantic part and clip, and runs as a fail-closed candidate-workflow gate. Heel, ball, and toe IDs are now selected once from the neutral idle sole and reused unchanged for both gait clips.
defects.expected_visible_result: Every semantic region remains finite, non-collapsed, non-inverted, above the floor where applicable, and clear of non-adjacent surface regions through every 120 Hz clip sample, with any threshold breach tied to an exact clip, time, part, and vertex/triangle witness.
defects.proof_contract: Run a fail-closed 120 Hz CPU skinning audit over the exact runtime-review GLB for all 66 joints, all deformed vertices, all triangles, all 16 semantic parts, and all 24 clips; retain per-part/per-clip minima and exact breach witnesses; combine with existing textured multi-angle evidence and obtain independent C2 re-review.
defects.latest_verification_note: Exact candidate 60a16ef0 exposed that the report-level passed flag did not aggregate per-clip part failures even though the workflow's final gate did. The evaluator now fails its own report whenever any clip row fails, preserving fail-closed consistency and naming the exact failed clips. Once production gates were green, exact candidate 490fd7b5 reached a latent preflight KeyError: the motion ledger exports derived_low-contact_stride_median but the workflow queried an underscore spelling. Both walk and run assertions now use the exact exported key.
defects.verification_disposition: Verified closed by exhaustive 120 Hz CPU skinning over 52,898 vertices, 96,001 triangles, 16 semantic parts and all 24 clips with zero violations; C2 passed 1,612/1,612 coverage rows at 9.42.
